sloka: ृष्टा धूम्राक्षं पर्यवारयन् ।परिघैर्बिन्दिपालैश्च भल्लैः प्रासैः परश्वधैः ।निर्ययू राक्षसा दिग्भ्योनर्दन्तो जलदा यथा ।। ६.५१.२५ ।।।।
transliteration: ṛṣṭā dhūmrākṣaṁ paryavārayan ।parighairbindipālaiśca bhallaiḥ prāsaiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ ।niryayū rākṣasā digbhyonardanto jaladā yathā ।। 6.51.25 ।।।।

translations.english: The dreadful Rakshasas set out roaring like rain clouds armed with different kinds of weapons, like tridents, darts, maces, spears, iron bars, rods, even clubs, spears and slings, arrows in thousands.
